law.catch_line: Certification of certain persons employed in coal mines; powers and duties of the Board

text.section: Certification shall also be required for any additional tasks that the Board requires by regulation.

The Board may adopt regulations necessary or incidental to the performance of duties or the execution of powers conferred under this title. Such regulations shall be adopted in accordance with the provisions of Article 2 (§ 2.2-4006 et seq.) of the Administrative Process Act.
The Board may adopt regulations regarding on-site examinations of mine foremen conducted by mine inspectors pursuant to § 45.2-528.
